{{Quote|During the last war, he betrayed the Third Imperial Assault Fleet and escaped with a sizeable Republic bribe&mdash;which he used for facial reconfiguration.|An HK-51 unit|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Third Imperial Assault Fleet''' was a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] that was active during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The fleet was betrayed from within, and the culprit escaped with a sizeable bribe from the Republic that he used to pay for facial reconstruction.
